verdict.rationale: Google Drive API's Changes resource (google-drive-docs-35) combined with push notifications that let apps watch for and be notified of resource changes (google-drive-docs-9/19/28) is exactly the delta/cursor mechanism described in the story, letting a client fetch only what changed since last sync rather than re-crawling all files. Missing for 10: explicit mention of startPageToken/pageToken cursor semantics in the evidence pack, and independent/hands-on developer corroboration that delta sync works reliably in practice.
